options.title: Could the Mediterranean Sea really dry up?
options.first_line: Could the Mediterranean Sea really dry up?
options.first_frame: The whole Mediterranean Sea fills the map between Europe and Africa, its water rippling, MEDITERRANEAN SEA writing across it as the waterline starts to slip back from the coasts.

options.title: What happens if Gibraltar closes and the Mediterranean dries up?
options.first_line: What happens to the Mediterranean if the gap at Gibraltar closes?
options.first_frame: A close view of the narrow Strait of Gibraltar between Spain and Morocco, the Atlantic pouring through it into the Mediterranean, a wall of rock rising to block it.

options.title: Why would the Mediterranean turn into a salt desert?
options.first_line: Why would the Mediterranean Sea turn into a desert of salt?
options.first_frame: The Mediterranean on the map, half of it already dry, white salt flats glittering where the water was and a last blue lake shrinking in the middle.

why: A sea you can picture turned into glittering salt flats makes a stranger ask how that is even possible, the answer (why) is held for the video, and the first frame says the most with the sound off; B gives away the outcome in its title and A is a plain yes/no.
